def parse_link_text(src: str, pos: int) ->Union[Tuple[str, int], Tuple[None,
    None]]:
    level = 1
    start = pos
    length = len(src)
    
    while pos < length:
        m = _INLINE_SQUARE_BRACKET_RE.search(src, pos)
        if not m:
            return None, None
        
        bracket = m.group(0)[-1]  # Get the actual bracket character (last char, after any backslashes)
        pos = m.end()
        
        if bracket == '[':
            level += 1
        elif bracket == ']':
            level -= 1
            if level == 0:
                text = src[start:m.end() - 1]
                return text, pos
    
    return None, None
